mainEntity.name: Should bathroom wall tile run horizontally or vertically?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The choice depends on design goals, wall dimensions, tile size, fixtures, and how much visual continuity you want. A horizontal pattern can make a wall feel wider, while a vertical arrangement can draw the eye upward; neither is automatically better.

The installer should check how the pattern lands at corners, niches, windows, and plumbing penetrations. A pattern that looks good in a sample may create narrow end cuts or misaligned joints across the actual room.

Key factors:
- Room proportions and ceiling height
- Tile shape and directional surface pattern
- Focal wall and fixture locations
- Grout-joint alignment at corners and openings

Review a measured elevation before ordering directional tile. Elite Remodeling & Design can compare layout options through design development and coordinate the selected pattern with the complete bathroom finish plan.
